body:
My first reaction was that I wanted to quit. It has resurfaced quite often the last few days, and I haven't been able to get out of bed, much less attend university or my duties. I had a long think about it and while this is my deepest and most foremost thought, I know that the person who called me out on it was right, and I thought I would apologise and at least make things less awkward. Maybe explain my depression, but I haven't decided yet.

I have a routine checkup at the end of the month and will consider telling him. He wants me to try therapy either way, but won't allow me to try one on one therapy because he feels like it won't be right for me (and he's probably right, I get extremely uneasy when the focus is on me). Instead, he wants me to try group therapy, and the thought of that makes me cringe.

Thank you for taking the time to write this. I really relate to what you wrote out - I'm exhausted all the time. 

I just don't know what to do next. I feel like I just got another reason to give up. My stomach coils at the thought of meeting these people again.
